title: D.D.C. opinion documents Democracy Partners Suite 250 operations in 2016
summary: A federal district-court opinion states that Democracy Partners and Strategic Consulting operated from Suite 250 at 1250 Eye Street NW in 2016; this bounds the historical office record but does not establish the later move date to Suite 330.
